Team section

Web·by @dawood_adib·2026-08-22·inspora page·original post

What it is

Team section morph: an editorial team page - giant black 'TEAM' wordmark with a live index counter (01-06); the member portrait (rendered in a grainy stipple/dither treatment) dissolves between people (Edward Hank, Marcus Chen, Julian Cross, Priya Anand, Samuel Osei...) with a pixel-noise morph, while a spec list (name, role, socials) crossfades on the right.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-30%
Counter 01->03: portrait dissolves via stipple noise - the old face breaks into scattered dots that reform as the next face (noise threshold wipe); name + detail list swap.
30-60%
03->05: same dither dissolve; portraits are grayscale with heavy grain; counter digits roll; right list rows fade/slide.
60-100%
05->06->01 (wraps); dissolve keeps a consistent stipple density so the image never fully empties - faces morph directly through the noise field.

Mechanics

trigger
auto-advance (or arrow/index click) every ~3s
elements
wordmark + index counter, stipple portrait (canvas), detail list
properties
noise-threshold dissolve between images, counter roll, list crossfade
timing
dissolve 800ms; hold 2.2s; list swap 300ms
easing
dissolve ease-in-out on threshold
loop
infinite through roster

Build prompt

Build a team section with a dither morph. Layout: left - 'TEAM' in 96px black grotesk with a tabular index (01/06) beside it; center - 300x380 portrait canvas; right - member name (15px semibold) + spec rows (role, location, socials) in 12px muted. The portrait: convert each headshot to an ordered-dither/stipple bitmap (Bayer 4x4 threshold at ~70% density, grayscale). Transition between members by animating the threshold 0->1 against a per-pixel random value: pixels of the OLD image whose random value < t drop out while pixels of the NEW image with value < (1-t)... - effectively both images live in one noise field and the wipe reads as grainy dissolution, 800ms ease-in-out, run on canvas with an ImageData swap per frame (precompute both dithered bitmaps + a fixed random field). Counter rolls digits (translateY strip, 300ms); detail rows crossfade + rise 6px (250ms, 40ms stagger). Auto-advance every 3s, wrap at roster end.
